runtime_input_policy.reference_usage: camera, composition, light, support surface and declared container design only
runtime_input_policy.copyright_rule: Rebuild a new scene; never copy the reference beverage, exact wall marks, exact shadow silhouette or pixel layout.

allowed_style_features: fine vertical fluted glass when container adoption is selected

micro_moments: the drink has just been set down
window light settles softly across the table

tone_contract.background_plane: one warm-neutral matte white wall meeting one matte white tabletop
tone_contract.color_bias: warm-neutral white with quiet cooler gray shadows, never beige
tone_contract.highlight_behavior: soft shoulder with visible wall, table and glass detail and no clipped broad white area

composition.camera_angle: product-level to very slightly elevated frontal view
composition.camera_height: near the upper third of the product
composition.depth_of_field: product fully legible; real wall and table planes retain gentle texture without portrait blur
composition.alignment: small product in the lower field with broad top-heavy quiet space

lighting.type: one very large diffused natural window source
lighting.shadow: soft, attached and low-density with gentle rightward falloff
lighting.highlight_control: retain white surface texture, glass rim thickness and beverage color without clipping

scene.texture: subtle real wall and tabletop irregularity with no decorative pattern

capture.look: natural Instagram cafe photograph with quiet deliberate framing
capture.realism: one physical exposure, natural glass optics, attached shadow and finite social-photo acuity
capture.grain: faint luminance grain after ordinary social compression

editable: container only when adopt_reference is selected
reference_exclusions: do not copy the reference coffee
do not copy exact wall marks or shadow
do not copy or invent text

prompt_blocks.input_roles: Image 1 supplies the exact user product identity. Image 2 supplies only the declared white scene grammar and, in adopt mode, the unbranded fluted-glass design.
prompt_blocks.composition: Keep one complete product at 16-24 percent frame height and no more than 18 percent width, with at least 68 percent meaningful white wall-and-table space and the wall-table boundary near y=0.80-0.84.
prompt_blocks.look: Use one very large diffused window source from the left, subdued warm-neutral white color, gentle tonal falloff and finite Instagram capture acuity.
prompt_blocks.preservation: Rerender the product under the target camera and light; preserve beverage identity, serving state and final brand contract without pasted source pixels.
prompt_blocks.negative: No direct sunbeam, hard graphic shadow, hero close-up, studio sweep, uniform blur, cutout edge, copied reference beverage, fake text, logo or watermark.

quality_gates.logo_text: only the resolved target brand contract is allowed; unbranded means no text or mark
quality_gates.product_identity: beverage, serving state, layers and toppings remain recognizable
quality_gates.preset_adherence: product scale, negative space, boundary height, normal perspective and one diffuse left light meet the numeric contract
quality_gates.artifact_policy: reject pasted edges, detached shadows, clipped whites, malformed glass, copied wall marks and generic AI minimalist template reading

failure_recovery: reduce product to the contracted bbox
restore at least 68 percent meaningful space
add only subtle physical wall and table variation
